summary: Implemented the window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False, with the Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for title controls. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with one bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run or committed, so tests and mypy are unverified. The Console test returns early on legacy Windows, skipping the result assertion as well as the output assertion.
